editorial:
Imagine being a royal prince who has never done a single thing for himself. That is exactly where you find Prince Hubert in this funny story. He has lived his entire life wrapped in cotton wool, with servants doing every little task. When he finally gets a taste of independence, it is a total disaster in the best way possible. You will love watching him struggle with basic things that we take for granted, like ordering food or navigating the real world. The vibe is light, silly, and feels like a classic fish-out-of-water story that does not take itself too seriously.

The acting is the best part because the lead plays the clueless prince perfectly. While the plot is simple and moves at a steady clip, some of the jokes might feel a bit repetitive. However, if you are looking for a mindless laugh, this is your go-to pick.
endingExplained: By the end, Hubert realizes that being a prince is not about the fancy titles, but about being a decent person. After a series of clumsy mistakes, he finally learns how to take care of himself and makes real friends. He does not give up his throne, but he changes how he leads. The movie wraps up with him finding a balance between his royal duties and his new desire for a normal, independent life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies about rich people learning life lessons.
